title: Construction of sectionwise Artin-Schreier maps
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and p a prime with p = 0 in its global functions. For the lifted étale structure-module sheaf G [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] there are natural additive equivalences a_U from G(U) to Γ(U,O_U), morphisms wp:G→G and iota from the constant Z/p sheaf [def-sc-constant-sheaves] to G with zero composite, such that wp is x↦x^p-x under a and iota sends constant c to c.val. No exactness is asserted.

source.place: Opening Artin-Schreier short exact sequence for every scheme in characteristic p, together with the proof of Tag 03PL for local surjectivity.

proof.text: Use artinSchreier_construction for X, then transport its additive section equivalences through the inverse sheaf isomorphism. Naturality of that inverse and the supplied restriction formula give the section equivalences for the fixed lifted tensor-section sheaf.

Pull hp back to every etale object. For nontrivial section rings install characteristic p using primality; for trivial rings use subsingleton elimination. Thus p-th powers are additive. Conjugate x^p-x by the additive section equivalences; preservation of powers and subtraction by restriction ring maps proves naturality and gives wp.

The characteristic ringChar of each section ring divides p because p vanishes. The ZMod castHom therefore supplies its prime-field ring map, including trivial section rings. Compose this map with ULift.down and the inverse section equivalence, then use sheafifyLift to construct iota. The sheafification unit identity proves the constant formula. Fermat via ZMod.pow_card makes the composite zero on the constant presheaf; sheafify_hom_ext gives iota followed by wp equal to zero.

proof_origin.place: Opening sequence: natural structure-module section identifications reused from artinSchreier_construction; maps and zero composite constructed using characteristic-p algebra and sheafification.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_artinSchreier_section_data (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hp : (p : Γ(X, ⊤)) = 0) :
    let G := (sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
      (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf (Modules.unit X))
    ∃ (a : ∀ U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
      (wp : G ⟶ G) (iota : X.constantZMod p ⟶ G) (hzero : iota ≫ wp = 0),
      (∀ (U V : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
        a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x)) ∧
      (∀ (U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
        a U (wp.hom.app U x) = (a U x) ^ p - a U x) ∧
      (∀ (U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (c : ZMod p),
        a U (iota.hom.app U
          ((toSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology
            ((Functor.const X.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p))))).app U (ULift.up c))) =
          (c.val : Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤)))
